description: Recharts-based data visualization components including BarChart, LineChart, AreaChart, PieChart, and DonutChart. Provides CHART_COLORS and SEMANTIC_CHART_COLORS palettes aligned with the design token system, plus ChartContainer and ChartTooltip utilities.
useCases: Trend analysis of response rates over time (line/area charts)
NPS score breakdowns and satisfaction metric dashboards
Comparative analytics across survey segments or cohorts
